title: Budget blocks a correctly sized purchase: rank options, request an override
description: Coca-Cola 1.5L at Usaquén needs ~714 units and the recommendation (720) is within tolerance. But only 2.0M COP of the beverages budget remains, enough for 342 units, which stocks out on day 7. The agent ranks the options. The full quantity needs a human budget override; the budget-capped buy stocks out.
rationale: horizon = lead 2 + review 7 = 9; demand = 80 x 9 = 720; safety = 3 x 80 = 240; available 250; no inbound
recommendation 720 is within tolerance (|720-714|/714 = 0.84%) but 720 x 5,800 = 4,176,000 > remaining budget 30,000,000-22,000,000-6,000,000 = 2,000,000 -> cannot ACCEPT
without action: d0 170, d1 90, d2 10, d3 -70 -> stockout on day 3

option A, full 714: value 4,141,200 COP > budget 2,000,000 (needs BUDGET_OVERRIDE) and > auto limit 3,000,000 (OVER_AUTO_LIMIT); no stockout, cover (90+714)/80 = 10.05 <= 30; storage free 5000-(3000-250)-90 = 2160
option B, budget-capped: floor(2,000,000/5,800)=344 -> case 6 -> 342 (1,983,600 COP). Arrives on 90: d2 352, d3 272, d4 192, d5 112, d6 32, d7 -48, d8 -128 -> 128 units unmet from day 7
constraint priority: budget is hard UNLESS a human overrides it, and avoiding stockout ranks above cost -> A is ranked first and routed to approval, B is the fallback if the override is refused
approval given -> submit 714 -> confirmed -> outcome check: lowest level d8 = 804 - 7x80 = 244 >= 0
